  -e HF_TOKEN=$HF_TOKEN \

  -e VLLM_FLOAT32_MATMUL_PRECISION=high \
  -e NODE_RANK="$NODE_RANK" \
  -e HEAD_IP="$HEAD_IP" \

  -v "$HF_CACHE_DIR:/root/.cache/huggingface" \
  -v "$HOME/.cache/vllm:/root/.cache/vllm" \
  -v "$HOME/.cache/flashinfer:/root/.cache/flashinfer" \
  -v "$HOME/.triton:/root/.triton" \
  --entrypoint /bin/bash \

models.summary: Muse Spark Open 816B mixture-of-experts model with 42B active parameters.

prerequisites: Eight DGX Spark nodes with 128 GB of memory per node and a configured ConnectX RoCE network through a QSFP switch.
Docker with NVIDIA GPU support and the specified image available on every node.

Hugging Face access to the target and draft checkpoints. Cache target revision `4239e4db19376904f2e82c167e78f70abb5455fe` and draft revision `fbec887a79866e9ecff6c57adfd9fd02aa3cadea` in the Hugging Face cache on every node before setup; the image sets `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1`.
limitations: Requires a Muse Spark container image with Humming, B12x, and DFlash2 support.
recipes.security: Evaluation configuration only. Host networking exposes vLLM on host interfaces; use a firewall or reverse proxy, a scoped read-only HF token, and an isolated cache. For production, pin tested image, model, and code revisions.

topology.summary: 8× DGX Spark; 128 GB per node; one node rank per Spark; tensor parallel 8

runtime.label: Container (mutable, ARM64, custom Muse Spark)
runtime.setup_instructions: Run on all eight nodes after setting `HF_TOKEN`. Use the same head node ConnectX address (`HEAD_IP`) and rendezvous port (`MASTER_PORT`) on every node. Set `ETH_IF` to the local ConnectX Ethernet interface for control traffic and `IB_IF` to both local RoCE host channel adapter names for data traffic.
runtime.setup_command:
# Example eight-Spark network values; adjust to the configured network:
#   HEAD_IP="10.100.32.1"               # head node's ConnectX address
#   ETH_IF="enp1s0f0np0"               # local Ethernet interface for control traffic
#   IB_IF="rocep1s0f0,roceP2p1s0f0"    # both local RoCE adapters for data traffic
export HEAD_IP="<head-connectx-ip>"
export ETH_IF="<connectx-interface>"
export IB_IF="<roce-interface-1>,<roce-interface-2>"
export MASTER_PORT=29501
export IMAGE="vllm/vllm:muse-spark-open-gb10"
export HF_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.cache/huggingface"

mkdir -p "$HF_CACHE_DIR" "$HOME/.cache/vllm" "$HOME/.cache/flashinfer" \
  "$HOME/.cache/b12x" "$HOME/.triton" "$HOME/.tilelang" "$HOME/.humming/cache" \
  "$HOME/.cache/vllm/muse-spark-draft-context-compile"

docker run --rm -it \
  --privileged \
  --gpus all \
  --ipc host \
  --network host \
  --shm-size=16g \
  --ulimit nofile=1048576:1048576 \
  --ulimit memlock=-1 \
  --ulimit stack=67108864 \
  -e HF_TOKEN=$HF_TOKEN \
  -e MN_IF_NAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e UCX_NET_DEVICES="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IB_HCA="$IB_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IB_DISABLE=0 \
  -e OMPI_MCA_btl_tcp_if_include="$ETH_IF" \
  -e GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e TP_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY=1 \
  -e HEAD_IP="$HEAD_IP" \
  -e MASTER_PORT="$MASTER_PORT" \
  -v "$HF_CACHE_DIR:/root/.cache/huggingface" \
  -v "$HOME/.cache/vllm:/root/.cache/vllm" \
  -v "$HOME/.cache/flashinfer:/root/.cache/flashinfer" \
  -v "$HOME/.cache/b12x:/root/.cache/b12x" \
  -v "$HOME/.triton:/root/.triton" \
  -v "$HOME/.tilelang:/root/.tilelang" \
  -v "$HOME/.humming/cache:/root/.humming/cache" \
  -v "$HOME/.cache/vllm/muse-spark-draft-context-compile:/tmp/muse-spark-draft-context-compile" \
  --entrypoint /bin/bash \
  "$IMAGE"

vllm serve meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4 \

  --max-num-batched-tokens 4096 \
  --reasoning-parser muse \
  --tool-call-parser muse \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --per-request-spec-decode-metrics summary \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"dflash","model":"nvidia/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-DFlash2","num_speculative_tokens":5,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","attention_backend":"TRITON_ATTN","revision":"fbec887a79866e9ecff6c57adfd9fd02aa3cadea","quantization":"mxfp8","linear_backend":"flashinfer_cutlass","enable_adaptive_verification":true}' \

recipes.notes: Use the same ConnectX-7 port on every node and assign its two subinterfaces to separate subnets. Start all seven workers before the head. Docker runs privileged. Humming uses `~/.humming/cache` by default. The compilation cache is persisted at `~/.cache/vllm/muse-spark-draft-context-compile` on each host. The target uses NVFP4 with the specified MXFP8 layer overrides; the DFlash2 draft uses MXFP8 with adaptive verification and up to five speculative tokens.

prerequisites: Two DGX Stations with one GB300 each, cabled over two 400 Gb/s ConnectX-8 RoCE v2 rails (`mlx5_0`, `mlx5_1`) with IPv4 addresses configured on both rails.
Docker on both nodes with GPU access and permission to run privileged containers (the launch needs `/dev/infiniband`).
About 520 GiB free per node in the model directory, and the head's management address reachable from the worker.
limitations: Validated on one Station pair with both rails in their factory configuration (MTU 1500, automatic RoCE v2 GID); not validated over a single rail.
Validated at concurrency 1 and 4; the server admits 4 sequences of up to 32,768 tokens (8 GiB KV cache per GPU, 55,903 tokens).
The BF16 routed experts of layers 0 and 61 are requantized to NVFP4 once per node, with activation scales borrowed from the neighbouring layers (no calibration). GSM8K 200 stayed at 97.0%.
The requantization step goes away once vllm-project/vllm#67136 and
24 GiB of routed experts per GPU stay in Grace memory. Less offload runs out of GPU memory, at startup (12 GiB) or on the first 8K-token prompt (4 GiB).

vLLM v0.34.0 pins FlashInfer 0.7.3, whose wheel ships the Muse norm backend (`cake_muse_spark_norm_backend`) without its `build.json`. The serve step then disables that backend so `rmsnorm_sigmoid_gate` runs on the CuTe DSL kernel; the step does nothing once FlashInfer ships the file. Text only; image and audio inputs were not tested.
recipes.security: Evaluation configuration only. Host networking exposes vLLM on host interfaces; use a firewall or reverse proxy, a scoped read-only HF token, and isolated model storage. The containers run privileged to reach `/dev/infiniband`; review this before use. For production, pin tested image, model, and code revisions.

topology.summary: 2× DGX Station with 1× GB300 each; one node rank per station; tensor parallel 2 over two 400 Gb/s ConnectX-8 RoCE v2 rails

runtime.label: Container (ARM64)
runtime.setup_instructions: Use Bash on both nodes and replace the placeholder. Each node downloads its own copy (497 GiB, 127 shards, plus the 8.2 GB DFlash2 drafter) and writes the requantization script (checked against its SHA-256) and the requantized checkpoint to `nvfp4rq/`. The script prints the borrowed activation scales; they must read 4.4474e-02 / 7.9304e-01 (layer 0) and 5.0595e-02 / 7.9657e-02 (layer 61).
runtime.setup_command:
set -euo pipefail HOST_DIR="" RAIL_HCAS=mlx5_0,mlx5_1 IMG=vllm/vllm-openai:v0.34.0 MODEL_REPO=unsloth/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4 DRAFT_REPO=nvidia/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-DFlash2 GPU_UUID=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=uuid,name --format=csv,noheader | awk -F', ' '/GB300/ {print $1; exit}') test -n "$GPU_UUID" for h in ${RAIL_HCAS//,/ }; do p=/sys/class/infiniband/$h/ports/1 echo "$h $(cat $p/state) $(cat $p/rate) $(cat $p/link_layer)" grep -q ACTIVE $p/state done nvidia-smi -q -d PERFORMANCE -i "$GPU_UUID" | grep -E 'HW Power Brak' mkdir -p "$HOST_DIR" # One-time requantization of the BF16 routed experts of layers 0 and 61. NVFP4 (ModelOpt layout, matches the checkpoint's layers 1..60):

U8 [E, R, C/2] two E2M1 codes per byte, low nibble = even column

_weight_scale F8_E4M3 [E, R, C/16] per-16-element block scale (amax_block / 6 / weight_scale_2)

_weight_scale_2 F32 [E] (down) / [E, 2] (gate_up: gate, up) per-expert global scale (amax / (6 * 448))

_input_scale F32 same shape as weight_scale_2; there is no activation calibration for these layers, and vLLM's TRT-LLM NVFP4 MoE uses static activation scales, so this writes the max input scale of the neighbour layers (layer 0: layers 1, 2; layer 61: layers 59, 60) gate_up gets one global scale per expert, shared by its gate and up halves (written twice), so the row order of the halves does not matter. Usage: python3 requant_nvfp4_vllm.py convert [device=cuda:0] dst gets symlinks to every src file, except the four BF16 expert shards (rewritten as NVFP4) and the configs/index (rewritten: layers 0/61 experts no longer excluded from quantization). python3 requant_nvfp4_vllm.py selftest quantize random data, check the round trip error and the byte packing """ import json import os import sys import torch E2M1 = torch.tensor([0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0]) # Midpoints between consecutive E2M1 magnitudes: |x| below bound i maps to code i. BOUNDS = torch.tensor([0.25, 0.75, 1.25, 1.75, 2.5, 3.5, 5.0]) FP8_MAX, FP4_MAX = 448.0, 6.0 def global_scale(w): """ModelOpt weight_scale_2: amax / (6 * 448), as float32 (amax over the whole tensor).""" return (w.abs().amax().float() / (FP4_MAX * FP8_MAX)).clamp(min=torch.finfo(torch.float32).tiny) def quantize(w, gs): """w [R, C] (any float dtype), gs scalar fp32 tensor -> (packed u8 [R, C/2], block scales f8e4m3 [R, C/16]).""" R, C = w.shape blocks = w.float().reshape(R, C // 16, 16) bmax = blocks.abs().amax(-1) scale = (bmax / FP4_MAX / gs).clamp(max=FP8_MAX).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn) denom = scale.float() * gs x = torch.where(denom[..., None] > 0, blocks / denom[..., None].clamp(min=torch.finfo(torch.float32).tiny), torch.zeros_like(blocks)) mag = torch.bucketize(x.abs().clamp(max=FP4_MAX), BOUNDS.to(x.device)) # 0..7 code = (mag | ((x < 0) & (mag > 0)).to(mag.dtype) << 3).to(torch.uint8).reshape(R, C) packed = code[:, 0::2] | (code[:, 1::2] << 4) return packed.contiguous(), scale.contiguous() def dequantize(packed, scale, gs): R, Ch = packed.shape lut = torch.cat([E2M1, -E2M1]).to(packed.device) vals = torch.empty(R, Ch * 2, device=packed.device) vals[:, 0::2] = lut[(packed & 0xF).long()] vals[:, 1::2] = lut[(packed >> 4).long()] return (vals.reshape(R, -1, 16) * (scale.float() * gs)[..., None]).reshape(R, Ch * 2) def quantize_experts(w, device): """w [E, R, C] BF16 (CPU, possibly mmapped) -> dict of NVFP4 tensors on CPU.""" E, R, C = w.shape packed = torch.empty(E, R, C // 2, dtype=torch.uint8) scale = torch.empty(E, R, C // 16, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn) gs = torch.empty(E, dtype=torch.float32) err = 0.0 for e in range(E): we = w[e].to(device) g = global_scale(we) p, s = quantize(we, g) packed[e], scale[e], gs[e] = p.cpu(), s.cpu(), g.cpu() if e % 64 == 0: d = dequantize(p, s, g) err = max(err, ((d - we.float()).norm() / we.float().norm()).item()) return packed, scale, gs, err def selftest(): torch.manual_seed(0) w = (torch.randn(64, 256) * 0.02).to(torch.bfloat16) w[3, 5] = 0.3 # an outlier g = global_scale(w) p, s = quantize(w, g) d = dequantize(p, s, g) rel = ((d - w.float()).norm() / w.float().norm()).item() # Packing: element 0 -> low nibble of byte 0, element 1 -> high nibble. v = torch.zeros(1, 16) v[0, 0], v[0, 1] = 6.0, -0.5 gp, gsc = quantize(v, torch.tensor(6.0 / (FP4_MAX * FP8_MAX))) assert gp[0, 0].item() == (7 | ((8 | 1) << 4)), gp[0, :2] assert rel < 0.12, rel assert torch.allclose(d[3, 5], torch.tensor(0.3), rtol=0.1) print(f"SELFTEST_OK rel_err={rel:.4f} outlier={d[3, 5].item():.4f}") # There is no activation calibration for layers 0/61. vLLM's TRT-LLM NVFP4 MoE quantizes activations with the static # input scale, so take the largest one of the two nearest NVFP4 layers (larger = no clipping, slightly coarser). NEIGHBOURS = {0: (1, 2), 61: (59, 60)} def neighbour_input_scale(src, wm, L, proj): from safetensors import safe_open best = 0.0 for n in NEIGHBOURS[L]: k = f"model.language_model.layers.{n}.mlp.experts.{proj}_input_scale" with safe_open(os.path.join(src, wm[k]), "pt") as fh: best = max(best, fh.get_tensor(k).float().max().item()) return best def convert(src, dst, device="cuda:0"): from safetensors import safe_open from safetensors.torch import save_file os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True) idx = json.load(open(os.path.join(src, "model.safetensors.index.json"))) wm = idx["weight_map"] targets = {} # shard -> (layer, proj) for L in (0, 61): for proj in ("gate_up_proj", "down_proj"): k = f"model.language_model.layers.{L}.mlp.experts.{proj}" targets[wm[k]] = (L, proj, k) for s, (L, proj, k) in targets.items(): assert sum(v == s for v in wm.values()) == 1, f"{s} holds more than {k}" for f in os.listdir(src): if f in targets or f in ("model.safetensors.index.json", "config.json", "hf_quant_config.json"): continue if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(dst, f)): os.symlink(os.path.join(src, f), os.path.join(dst, f)) for s, (L, proj, k) in sorted(targets.items()): out = os.path.join(dst, s) with safe_open(os.path.join(src, s), "pt") as fh: w = fh.get_tensor(k) assert w.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and w.dim() == 3, (k, w.dtype, w.shape) packed, scale, gs, err = quantize_experts(w, device) E = w.shape[0] tens = {k: packed, f"{k}_weight_scale": scale} a_s = neighbour_input_scale(src, wm, L, proj) if proj == "gate_up_proj": tens[f"{k}_weight_scale_2"] = gs[:, None].repeat(1, 2).contiguous() tens[f"{k}_input_scale"] = torch.full((E, 2), a_s, dtype=torch.float32) else: tens[f"{k}_weight_scale_2"] = gs.contiguous() tens[f"{k}_input_scale"] = torch.full((E,), a_s, dtype=torch.float32) print(f"REQUANT layer={L} {proj} input_scale={a_s:.4e} (max of layers {NEIGHBOURS[L]})", flush=True) save_file(tens, out + ".tmp", metadata={"format": "pt"}) os.replace(out + ".tmp", out) for name in tens: wm[name] = s print(f"REQUANT layer={L} {proj} {tuple(w.shape)} -> {tuple(packed.shape)} max_rel_err(sampled)={err:.4f} " f"gs[min,max]=({gs.min().item():.3e},{gs.max().item():.3e}) -> {out}", flush=True) del w, packed, scale json.dump(idx, open(os.path.join(dst, "model.safetensors.index.json"), "w"), indent=2) drop = {"model.language_model.layers.0.mlp.experts", "model.language_model.layers.61.mlp.experts"} cfg = json.load(open(os.path.join(src, "config.json"))) q = cfg["quantization_config"] q["modules_to_not_convert"] = [m for m in q["modules_to_not_convert"] if m not in drop] q["exclude_modules"] = [m for m in q.get("exclude_modules", []) if m not in ("layers.0.", "layers.61.")] json.dump(cfg, open(os.path.join(dst, "config.json"), "w"), indent=2) hq_path = os.path.join(src, "hf_quant_config.json") if os.path.exists(hq_path): hq = json.load(open(hq_path)) hq["quantization"]["exclude_modules"] = [m for m in hq["quantization"]["exclude_modules"] if m not in ("layers.0.", "layers.61.")] json.dump(hq, open(os.path.join(dst, "hf_quant_config.json"), "w"), indent=2) print(f"REQUANT_DONE dst={dst} modules_to_not_convert={len(q['modules_to_not_convert'])} " f"exclude_modules={q['exclude_modules']}", flush=True) if __name__ == "__main__": if sys.argv[1] == "selftest": selftest() elif sys.argv[1] == "convert": convert(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], *(sys.argv[4:5] or ["cuda:0"])) PY echo HF_HOME=/w/hf_home \ -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$GPU_UUID" --entrypoint bash "$IMG" -lc " set -euo pipefail hf download $MODEL_REPO --local-dir /w/nvfp4 test \$(ls /w/nvfp4/*.safetensors | wc -l) = 127 serve.label: Launch head
serve.instructions: Run after the worker launch, within a few minutes. Replace the placeholders with the same values as on the worker. Startup takes about 6 minutes.
serve.command:
set -euo pipefail

HEAD_MGMT_IP="<head-management-ip>"
HOST_DIR="<model-host-path>"
RAIL_HCAS=mlx5_0,mlx5_1
IMG=vllm/vllm-openai:v0.34.0
CONTAINER=muse-tp2
PORT=30000
RANK=0
HEADLESS=
SPEC_CONFIG='{"method":"dflash","model":"/w/draft","num_speculative_tokens":7}'
LAUNCH='set -euo pipefail
# FlashInfer 0.7.3 ships its Muse norm backend without build.json; fall back to the CuTe DSL kernel when the file is missing.
FI_DIR=$(python3 -c "import flashinfer, os; print(os.path.dirname(flashinfer.__file__))")
if [ ! -f "$FI_DIR/cake_muse_spark_norm_backend/build.json" ]; then
  sed -i "s/^    _HAS_CAKE_FUSED_NORM = True\$/    _HAS_CAKE_FUSED_NORM = False/" "$FI_DIR/norm/__init__.py"
fi
exec vllm "$@"'

NODE_MGMT_IP=$(ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 | awk '{for (i = 1; i < NF; i++) if ($i == "src") print $(i + 1)}')
MGMT_IFACE=$(ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 | awk '{for (i = 1; i < NF; i++) if ($i == "dev") print $(i + 1)}')
GPU_UUID=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=uuid,name --format=csv,noheader | awk -F', ' '/GB300/ {print $1; exit}')
test -n "$GPU_UUID"

docker rm -f "$CONTAINER" > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
docker run -d --name "$CONTAINER" --privileged --gpus device="$GPU_UUID" --network host --ipc host --shm-size 16g \
  --ulimit memlock=-1 --ulimit stack=67108864 -v "$HOST_DIR:/w" \
  -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$GPU_UUID" \
  -e NCCL_IB_HCA="$RAIL_HCAS" -e NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="$MGMT_IFACE" -e GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="$MGMT_IFACE" \
  -e NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE=1 -e NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL=5 -e NCCL_IB_TIMEOUT=22 -e NCCL_IB_RETRY_CNT=7 \
  -e NCCL_DEBUG=INFO -e NCCL_DEBUG_SUBSYS=INIT,NET -e NCCL_DEBUG_FILE='/tmp/nccl_%h_%p.log' \
  -e VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_FLASHINFER=0 -e VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_SYMM_MEM=0 \
  -e VLLM_HOST_IP="$NODE_MGMT_IP" -e VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=1800 \
  -e VLLM_WEIGHT_OFFLOADING_DISABLE_PIN_MEMORY=1 -e VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1 \
  -e PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True -e HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 \
  --entrypoint bash "$IMG" -c "$LAUNCH" bash serve /w/nvfp4rq \
    --served-model-name muse-spark-open --host 0.0.0.0 --port "$PORT" \
    --nnodes 2 --node-rank "$RANK" --master-addr "$HEAD_MGMT_IP" --master-port 29501 \
    --tensor-parallel-size 2 --max-model-len 32768 --max-num-seqs 4 \
    --trust-remote-code --disable-custom-all-reduce \
    --kv-cache-memory-bytes 8589934592 \
    --cpu-offload-gb 24 --cpu-offload-params experts \
    --hf-overrides '{"text_config": {"max_position_embeddings": 32768}}' \
    --kernel-config '{"enable_flashinfer_autotune": false}' \
    --speculative-config "$SPEC_CONFIG" \
    --reasoning-parser muse $HEADLESS

recipes.notes: Start the worker before the head. Both nodes need the same `nvfp4rq/` and `draft/` directories under the model path. Verify both NCCL logs (`docker exec muse-tp2 bash -c 'grep -h "NET/IB : Using" /tmp/nccl_*.log'`) show `mlx5_0` and `mlx5_1` over RoCE with GDRDMA channels and no `NET/Socket` fallback. Muse always reasons; vLLM streams the thinking in `delta.reasoning`, so clients that read only `reasoning_content` report a fake time to first token.

clients.python:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:30000/v1", api_key="EMPTY")
resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="muse-spark-open",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)

prerequisites: Docker with GPU access and permission to run a privileged container (the launch drops the page cache before loading).
About 520 GiB free in the model directory and about 290 GiB of free Grace memory for the offloaded experts.
limitations: The NVFP4 checkpoint (533 GB) exceeds the GPU's ~250 GiB; 264 GiB of routed experts stay in Grace memory and are read over NVLink-C2C (vLLM UVA offload, `--cpu-offload-params experts`).

The BF16 routed experts of layers 0 and 61 are requantized to NVFP4 once, with activation scales borrowed from the neighbouring layers (no calibration). GSM8K 200 is 96.0% (96.5% of the answered, 192/199).
The requantization step goes away once vllm-project/vllm#67136 and
Validated at concurrency 1 and 4; the server admits 4 sequences of up to 32,768 tokens (16 GiB KV cache, 55,903 tokens).

vLLM v0.34.0 pins FlashInfer 0.7.3, whose wheel ships the Muse norm backend (`cake_muse_spark_norm_backend`) without its `build.json`. The serve step then disables that backend so `rmsnorm_sigmoid_gate` runs on the CuTe DSL kernel; the step does nothing once FlashInfer ships the file. Text only; image and audio inputs were not tested.
recipes.security: Evaluation configuration only. Host networking exposes vLLM on host interfaces; use a firewall or reverse proxy, a scoped read-only HF token, and an isolated cache. The container runs privileged and writes to `/proc/sys/vm/drop_caches`; review this requirement before use. For production, pin tested image, model, and code revisions.

R, C = w.shape blocks = w.float().reshape(R, C // 16, 16) bmax = blocks.abs().amax(-1) scale = (bmax / FP4_MAX / gs).clamp(max=FP8_MAX).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn) denom = scale.float() * gs x = torch.where(denom[..., None] > 0, blocks / denom[..., None].clamp(min=torch.finfo(torch.float32).tiny), torch.zeros_like(blocks)) mag = torch.bucketize(x.abs().clamp(max=FP4_MAX), BOUNDS.to(x.device)) # 0..7 code = (mag | ((x < 0) & (mag > 0)).to(mag.dtype) << 3).to(torch.uint8).reshape(R, C) packed = code[:, 0::2] | (code[:, 1::2] << 4) return packed.contiguous(), scale.contiguous() def dequantize(packed, scale, gs): R, Ch = packed.shape lut = torch.cat([E2M1, -E2M1]).to(packed.device) vals = torch.empty(R, Ch * 2, device=packed.device) vals[:, 0::2] = lut[(packed & 0xF).long()] vals[:, 1::2] = lut[(packed >> 4).long()] return (vals.reshape(R, -1, 16) * (scale.float() * gs)[..., None]).reshape(R, Ch * 2) def quantize_experts(w, device): """w [E, R, C] BF16 (CPU, possibly mmapped) -> dict of NVFP4 tensors on CPU.""" E, R, C = w.shape packed = torch.empty(E, R, C // 2, dtype=torch.uint8) scale = torch.empty(E, R, C // 16, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn) gs = torch.empty(E, dtype=torch.float32) err = 0.0 for e in range(E): we = w[e].to(device) g = global_scale(we) p, s = quantize(we, g) packed[e], scale[e], gs[e] = p.cpu(), s.cpu(), g.cpu() if e % 64 == 0: d = dequantize(p, s, g) err = max(err, ((d - we.float()).norm() / we.float().norm()).item()) return packed, scale, gs, err def selftest(): torch.manual_seed(0) w = (torch.randn(64, 256) * 0.02).to(torch.bfloat16) w[3, 5] = 0.3 # an outlier g = global_scale(w) p, s = quantize(w, g) d = dequantize(p, s, g) rel = ((d - w.float()).norm() / w.float().norm()).item() # Packing: element 0 -> low nibble of byte 0, element 1 -> high nibble. v = torch.zeros(1, 16) v[0, 0], v[0, 1] = 6.0, -0.5 gp, gsc = quantize(v, torch.tensor(6.0 / (FP4_MAX * FP8_MAX))) assert gp[0, 0].item() == (7 | ((8 | 1) << 4)), gp[0, :2] assert rel < 0.12, rel assert torch.allclose(d[3, 5], torch.tensor(0.3), rtol=0.1) print(f"SELFTEST_OK rel_err={rel:.4f} outlier={d[3, 5].item():.4f}") # There is no activation calibration for layers 0/61. vLLM's TRT-LLM NVFP4 MoE quantizes activations with the static # input scale, so take the largest one of the two nearest NVFP4 layers (larger = no clipping, slightly coarser). NEIGHBOURS = {0: (1, 2), 61: (59, 60)} def neighbour_input_scale(src, wm, L, proj): from safetensors import safe_open best = 0.0 for n in NEIGHBOURS[L]: k = f"model.language_model.layers.{n}.mlp.experts.{proj}_input_scale" with safe_open(os.path.join(src, wm[k]), "pt") as fh: best = max(best, fh.get_tensor(k).float().max().item()) return best def convert(src, dst, device="cuda:0"): from safetensors import safe_open from safetensors.torch import save_file os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True) idx = json.load(open(os.path.join(src, "model.safetensors.index.json"))) wm = idx["weight_map"] targets = {} # shard -> (layer, proj) for L in (0, 61): for proj in ("gate_up_proj", "down_proj"): k = f"model.language_model.layers.{L}.mlp.experts.{proj}" targets[wm[k]] = (L, proj, k) for s, (L, proj, k) in targets.items(): assert sum(v == s for v in wm.values()) == 1, f"{s} holds more than {k}" for f in os.listdir(src): if f in targets or f in ("model.safetensors.index.json", "config.json", "hf_quant_config.json"): continue if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(dst, f)): os.symlink(os.path.join(src, f), os.path.join(dst, f)) for s, (L, proj, k) in sorted(targets.items()): out = os.path.join(dst, s) with safe_open(os.path.join(src, s), "pt") as fh: w = fh.get_tensor(k) assert w.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and w.dim() == 3, (k, w.dtype, w.shape) packed, scale, gs, err = quantize_experts(w, device) E = w.shape[0] tens = {k: packed, f"{k}_weight_scale": scale} a_s = neighbour_input_scale(src, wm, L, proj) if proj == "gate_up_proj": tens[f"{k}_weight_scale_2"] = gs[:, None].repeat(1, 2).contiguous() tens[f"{k}_input_scale"] = torch.full((E, 2), a_s, dtype=torch.float32) else: tens[f"{k}_weight_scale_2"] = gs.contiguous() tens[f"{k}_input_scale"] = torch.full((E,), a_s, dtype=torch.float32) print(f"REQUANT layer={L} {proj} input_scale={a_s:.4e} (max of layers {NEIGHBOURS[L]})", flush=True) save_file(tens, out + ".tmp", metadata={"format": "pt"}) os.replace(out + ".tmp", out) for name in tens: wm[name] = s print(f"REQUANT layer={L} {proj} {tuple(w.shape)} -> {tuple(packed.shape)} max_rel_err(sampled)={err:.4f} " f"gs[min,max]=({gs.min().item():.3e},{gs.max().item():.3e}) -> {out}", flush=True) del w, packed, scale json.dump(idx, open(os.path.join(dst, "model.safetensors.index.json"), "w"), indent=2) drop = {"model.language_model.layers.0.mlp.experts", "model.language_model.layers.61.mlp.experts"} cfg = json.load(open(os.path.join(src, "config.json"))) q = cfg["quantization_config"] q["modules_to_not_convert"] = [m for m in q["modules_to_not_convert"] if m not in drop] q["exclude_modules"] = [m for m in q.get("exclude_modules", []) if m not in ("layers.0.", "layers.61.")] json.dump(cfg, open(os.path.join(dst, "config.json"), "w"), indent=2) hq_path = os.path.join(src, "hf_quant_config.json") if os.path.exists(hq_path): hq = json.load(open(hq_path)) hq["quantization"]["exclude_modules"] = [m for m in hq["quantization"]["exclude_modules"] if m not in ("layers.0.", "layers.61.")] json.dump(hq, open(os.path.join(dst, "hf_quant_config.json"), "w"), indent=2) print(f"REQUANT_DONE dst={dst} modules_to_not_convert={len(q['modules_to_not_convert'])} " f"exclude_modules={q['exclude_modules']}", flush=True) if __name__ == "__main__": if sys.argv[1] == "selftest": selftest() elif sys.argv[1] == "convert": convert(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], *(sys.argv[4:5] or ["cuda:0"])) PY echo "71b7720a0b565fe11d97fa06e74cc9f0180369b0054a89401722e05829ffe85e $HOST_DIR/requant_nvfp4_vllm.py" | sha256sum -c - docker run --rm --network host --gpus device="$GPU_UUID" -v "$HOST_DIR:/w" -e HF_HOME=/w/hf_home \ -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$GPU_UUID" --entrypoint bash "$IMG" -lc " set -euo pipefail hf download $MODEL_REPO --local-dir /w/nvfp4 test \$(ls /w/nvfp4/*.safetensors | wc -l) = 127 hf download $DRAFT_REPO --local-dir /w/draft python3 /w/requant_nvfp4_vllm.py convert /w/nvfp4 /w/nvfp4rq cuda:0 "

serve.label: Start TP=1 with UVA expert offload and DFlash2
serve.instructions: Use Bash, replace the placeholder with the same value used during setup, and run on an otherwise idle station. Weights load in about 6.5 minutes.
serve.command:
set -euo pipefail

HOST_DIR="<model-host-path>"
IMG=vllm/vllm-openai:v0.34.0
CONTAINER=muse-1station
PORT=30000

GPU_UUID=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=uuid,name --format=csv,noheader | awk -F', ' '/GB300/ {print $1; exit}')
test -n "$GPU_UUID"

docker rm -f "$CONTAINER" > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
docker run -d --name "$CONTAINER" --privileged --gpus device="$GPU_UUID" --network host --ipc host --shm-size 16g \
  --ulimit memlock=-1 --ulimit stack=67108864 -v "$HOST_DIR:/w" \
  -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$GPU_UUID" -e PORT="$PORT" \
  -e VLLM_WEIGHT_OFFLOADING_DISABLE_PIN_MEMORY=1 -e HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 \
  --entrypoint bash "$IMG" -lc '
    set -euo pipefail
    sync
    echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches
    # FlashInfer 0.7.3 ships its Muse norm backend without build.json; fall back to the CuTe DSL kernel when the file is missing.
    FI_DIR=$(python3 -c "import flashinfer, os; print(os.path.dirname(flashinfer.__file__))")
    if [ ! -f "$FI_DIR/cake_muse_spark_norm_backend/build.json" ]; then
      sed -i "s/^    _HAS_CAKE_FUSED_NORM = True\$/    _HAS_CAKE_FUSED_NORM = False/" "$FI_DIR/norm/__init__.py"
    fi
    exec vllm serve /w/nvfp4rq \
      --served-model-name muse-spark-open --host 0.0.0.0 --port "$PORT" --trust-remote-code \
      --tensor-parallel-size 1 --max-model-len 32768 --max-num-seqs 4 \
      --cpu-offload-gb 264 --cpu-offload-params experts \
      --kv-cache-memory-bytes 17179869184 \
      --hf-overrides "{\"text_config\": {\"max_position_embeddings\": 32768}}" \
      --speculative-config "{\"method\":\"dflash\",\"model\":\"/w/draft\",\"num_speculative_tokens\":7,\"draft_sample_method\":\"probabilistic\",\"rejection_sample_method\":\"block\",\"enable_adaptive_verification\":true}" \
      --reasoning-parser muse \
      --kernel-config "{\"enable_flashinfer_autotune\": false}"
  '

recipes.notes: Compared with default vLLM settings, layers 0/61 are requantized (34 GiB less to read from Grace memory), the RoPE tables are sized for 32K positions (vLLM otherwise builds a 1M-position table per layer, ~11.5 GiB of GPU memory), and DFlash2 uses 7 draft tokens with adaptive verification. Muse always reasons; vLLM streams the thinking in `delta.reasoning`, so clients that read only `reasoning_content` report a fake time to first token.

    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)

#   IB_IF="rocep1s0f0,roceP2p1s0f0"    # both local RoCE adapters for data traffic
export HEAD_IP="<head-connectx-ip>"
export ETH_IF="<connectx-interface>"
export IB_IF="<roce-interface-1>,<roce-interface-2>"
export MASTER_PORT=29501
export IMAGE="vllm/vllm-openai:minimax-m31-flash"
export HF_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.cache/huggingface"

mkdir -p "$HF_CACHE_DIR" "$HOME/.cache/vllm" "$HOME/.cache/flashinfer" "$HOME/.triton"

docker run --rm -it \
  --privileged \
  --gpus all \
  --ipc host \
  --network host \
  --shm-size=16g \
  --ulimit nofile=1048576:1048576 \
  --ulimit memlock=-1 \
  --ulimit stack=67108864 \
  -e MN_IF_NAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e UCX_NET_DEVICES="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IB_HCA="$IB_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IB_DISABLE=0 \
  -e OMPI_MCA_btl_tcp_if_include="$ETH_IF" \
  -e GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e TP_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY=1 \
  -e NCCL_MAX_CTAS=8 \
  -e HEAD_IP="$HEAD_IP" \
  -e MASTER_PORT="$MASTER_PORT" \
  -v "$HF_CACHE_DIR:/root/.cache/huggingface" \
  -v "$HOME/.cache/vllm:/root/.cache/vllm" \
  -v "$HOME/.cache/flashinfer:/root/.cache/flashinfer" \
  -v "$HOME/.triton:/root/.triton" \
  --entrypoint /bin/bash \
  "$IMAGE"

runtime.label: Container
runtime.setup_instructions: Run on every node after setting `HF_TOKEN`; replace the node-specific placeholders.
runtime.setup_command:
# Example two-Spark values (adjust to your network):
#   HEAD_IP="10.100.32.1"        # head node IP on the ETH subnet
#   ETH_IF="enp1s0f0np0"        # ConnectX baseboard ethernet (socket/control)
#   IB_IF="rocep1s0f0,roceP2p1s0f0"   # RoCE HCA names (data plane) - use both "twins"!
export HEAD_IP="<head-connectx-ip>"
export ETH_IF="<connectx-interface>"
export IB_IF="<roce-interface-1>,<roce-interface-2>"
export MASTER_PORT=29501
export NODE_RANK="<0-1>"
export IMAGE="vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0"
export HF_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.cache/huggingface"

mkdir -p "$HF_CACHE_DIR" "$HOME/.cache/vllm" "$HOME/.cache/flashinfer" "$HOME/.triton"

docker run --rm -it \
  --privileged \
  --gpus all \
  --ipc host \
  --network host \
  --shm-size=16g \
  --ulimit nofile=1048576:1048576 \
  --ulimit memlock=-1 \
  --ulimit stack=67108864 \
  -e HF_TOKEN=$HF_TOKEN \

runtime.setup_command:
docker run --rm -it \
  --gpus all \
  --ipc host \
  --network host \
  --shm-size=16g \
  --ulimit memlock=-1 \
  --ulimit stack=67108864 \
  -e HF_TOKEN=$HF_TOKEN \
  -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface \
  --entrypoint /bin/bash \
  vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0

serve.label: Launch
serve.command:
export VLLM_HAS_FLASHINFER_CUBIN=1

vllm serve nvidia/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --quantization modelopt_fp4 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --block-size 128 \
  --moe-backend marlin \
  --attention-backend FLASHINFER \
  --attention-config '{"use_trtllm_attention":true}' \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
  --max-num-seqs 8 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
  --async-scheduling \
  --enable-chunked-prefill \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  --skip-mm-profiling \
  --load-format fastsafetensors \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":4,"moe_backend":"flashinfer_cutlass"}'

prerequisites: A CUDA-enabled Windows x86-64 llama.cpp build b12387, source commit a956a852c9c8bc1fb07206364838ddef299178c0, with llama-server.exe on PATH.
Network access for llama-server to download and cache the named Hugging Face checkpoint files.

topology.summary: 2× DGX Spark; one node rank per Spark; tensor parallel 2

runtime.label: Container
runtime.setup_instructions: Run on every node after setting `HF_TOKEN`; replace the node-specific placeholders.
runtime.setup_command:
# Example two-Spark values (adjust to your network):
#   HEAD_IP="10.100.32.1"        # head node IP on the ETH subnet
#   ETH_IF="enp1s0f0np0"        # ConnectX baseboard ethernet (socket/control)
#   IB_IF="rocep1s0f0,roceP2p1s0f0"   # RoCE HCA names (data plane) - use both "twins"!
export HEAD_IP="<head-connectx-ip>"
export ETH_IF="<connectx-interface>"
export IB_IF="<roce-interface-1>,<roce-interface-2>"
export MASTER_PORT=29501
export NODE_RANK="<0-1>"
export IMAGE="vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0"
export HF_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.cache/huggingface"

mkdir -p "$HF_CACHE_DIR" "$HOME/.cache/vllm" "$HOME/.cache/flashinfer" "$HOME/.triton"

docker run --rm -it \
  --privileged \
  --gpus all \
  --ipc host \
  --network host \
  --shm-size=16g \
  --ulimit nofile=1048576:1048576 \
  --ulimit memlock=-1 \
  --ulimit stack=67108864 \
  -e HF_TOKEN=$HF_TOKEN \
  -e MN_IF_NAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e UCX_NET_DEVICES="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IB_HCA="$IB_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IB_DISABLE=0 \
  -e OMPI_MCA_btl_tcp_if_include="$ETH_IF" \
  -e GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e TP_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY=1 \
  -e VLLM_FLOAT32_MATMUL_PRECISION=high \
  -e NODE_RANK="$NODE_RANK" \
  -e HEAD_IP="$HEAD_IP" \
  -e MASTER_PORT="$MASTER_PORT" \
  -v "$HF_CACHE_DIR:/root/.cache/huggingface" \
  -v "$HOME/.cache/vllm:/root/.cache/vllm" \
  -v "$HOME/.cache/flashinfer:/root/.cache/flashinfer" \
  -v "$HOME/.triton:/root/.triton" \
  --entrypoint /bin/bash \
  "$IMAGE"

serve.label: Launch head
serve.command:
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER="1"

vllm serve nvidia/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 8000 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.8 \
  --max-model-len 262144 \
  --max-num-seqs 8 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 \
  --enable-chunked-prefill \
  --async-scheduling \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"dflash","model": "z-lab/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2", "num_speculative_tokens":8, "draft_tensor_parallel_size": 2}' \
  --load-format safetensors \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3 \
  --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
  --nnodes 2 \
  --node-rank $NODE_RANK \
  --master-addr "$HEAD_IP" \
  --master-port "$MASTER_PORT"

  --load-format safetensors \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3 \
  --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \

  --nnodes 2 \

  --master-addr "$HEAD_IP" \
  --master-port "$MASTER_PORT" \
  --headless

recipes.notes: Use the same CX7 port on every node; assign both port subinterfaces on separate subnets; cache the image and checkpoint on every node; start workers before the head. Docker runs privileged. For text-only use, add `--language-model-only` to the vLLM command: the vision encoder is not loaded, which shortens startup and frees its memory, and multimodal inputs are rejected.

runtime.label: Container
runtime.setup_instructions: Run on each node. Set its GB300 UUID, observed RoCE interface/HCA names, shared head address, and private node-local storage paths. The first container downloads the pinned checkpoint without using a GPU; after it finishes, the second opens the serving container. Start the worker serve command before the head. Use the same pinned snapshot and image on both nodes.
runtime.setup_command:
set -euo pipefail
export GB300_UUID="<this-node-GB300-UUID>"
export ETH_IF="<observed-control-RoCE-interface>"
export IB_HCAS="<observed-RoCE-HCA-1>,<observed-RoCE-HCA-2>"
export HEAD_IP="<head-RoCE-ip>"
export TARGET_SNAPSHOT="<absolute-node-local-directory>/482ca0f3832238542f8f5295dde86b5f22711d80"
export HF_CACHE_DIR="<absolute-node-local-private-hf-cache>"
export IMAGE="vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:c1c9f6fd5c109ba7f0546a59f5b2f15fb87f64c77782e90a27b648b42a8e67c3"

umask 077
mkdir -p "$TARGET_SNAPSHOT" "$HF_CACHE_DIR"
docker run --rm -i \
  --network host \
  --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" \
  -e HOME=/tmp \
  -e HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1 \
  -v "$TARGET_SNAPSHOT:/models/target" \
  --entrypoint python3 \
  "$IMAGE" - <<'PY'
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
snapshot_download(
    "nvidia/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4",
    revision="482ca0f3832238542f8f5295dde86b5f22711d80",
    local_dir="/models/target",
    max_workers=8,
)
PY

docker run --rm -it \
  --gpus "device=$GB300_UUID" \
  --ipc host \
  --network host \
  --shm-size=16g \
  --device=/dev/infiniband:/dev/infiniband \
  --cap-add IPC_LOCK \
  --ulimit memlock=-1 \
  --ulimit stack=67108864 \
  -e NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IB_HCA="$IB_HCAS" \
  -e NCCL_IB_DISABLE=0 \
  -e HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 \
  -e TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 \
  -e CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID \
  -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$GB300_UUID" \
  -e HEAD_IP="$HEAD_IP" \
  -v "$TARGET_SNAPSHOT:/models/target:ro" \
  -v "$HF_CACHE_DIR:/root/.cache/huggingface" \

recipes.notes:
This experimental two-node seed uses tensor parallel 2 with no speculative decoding and one GB300 per node. Auxiliary RTX GPUs must remain excluded. Set the observed RoCE interface and HCA names for each node; device visibility and peer reachability do not establish data-path bandwidth.

The card is AIPerf's aggregate active-decode rate at concurrency 16, the mean of two runs of 160 measured requests after 48 warmups, counting reasoning tokens; 78 of the 320 responses hit the 8192-token cap. At concurrency 1 the same two Stations measured 128.67 tok/s.

For text-only use, add `--language-model-only` to the vLLM command on both nodes: the vision encoder is not loaded, which shortens startup and frees its memory, and multimodal inputs are rejected.

prerequisites: Two DGX Spark nodes with 128 GB of memory per node and the ConnectX/RoCE network configured as described below.
Docker with NVIDIA GPU support and the image and checkpoint cached on both nodes.
limitations: The source requires the custom B12x container image.
recipes.security: Evaluation configuration only. Host networking exposes vLLM on host interfaces; use a firewall or reverse proxy, a scoped read-only HF token, and an isolated cache. For production, pin tested image, model, and code revisions.

topology.summary: 2× DGX Spark; one node rank per Spark; tensor parallel 2

runtime.label: Container (community, ARM64, custom B12x)
runtime.setup_instructions: Run on every node after setting `HF_TOKEN`; replace the node-specific placeholders.
runtime.setup_command:
# Example two-Spark values (adjust to your network):
#   HEAD_IP="10.100.32.1"        # head node IP on the ETH subnet
#   ETH_IF="enp1s0f0np0"        # ConnectX baseboard ethernet (socket/control)
#   IB_IF="rocep1s0f0,roceP2p1s0f0"   # RoCE HCA names (data plane) - use both "twins"!
export HEAD_IP="<head-connectx-ip>"
export ETH_IF="<connectx-interface>"
export IB_IF="<roce-interface-1>,<roce-interface-2>"
export MASTER_PORT=29501
export IMAGE="eugr/spark-vllm-b12x:nightly-20261015"
export HF_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.cache/huggingface"

mkdir -p "$HF_CACHE_DIR" "$HOME/.cache/vllm" "$HOME/.cache/flashinfer" "$HOME/.triton" "$HOME/.cache/b12x"

docker run --rm -it \
  --privileged \
  --gpus all \
  --ipc host \
  --network host \
  --shm-size=16g \
  --ulimit nofile=1048576:1048576 \
  --ulimit memlock=-1 \
  --ulimit stack=67108864 \
  -e HF_TOKEN=$HF_TOKEN \
  -e MN_IF_NAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e UCX_NET_DEVICES="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IB_HCA="$IB_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IB_DISABLE=0 \
  -e OMPI_MCA_btl_tcp_if_include="$ETH_IF" \
  -e GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e TP_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY=1 \
  -e HEAD_IP="$HEAD_IP" \
  -e MASTER_PORT="$MASTER_PORT" \
  -v "$HF_CACHE_DIR:/root/.cache/huggingface" \
  -v "$HOME/.cache/vllm:/root/.cache/vllm" \
  -v "$HOME/.cache/flashinfer:/root/.cache/flashinfer" \
  -v "$HOME/.triton:/root/.triton" \
  -v $HOME/.cache/b12x:/root/.cache/b12x \
  --entrypoint /bin/bash \
  "$IMAGE"

serve.label: Launch head
serve.command:
export VLLM_PLE_TABLE_MEMORY="shared"
export VLLM_ENABLE_ROCE_ALLREDUCE="1"
export VLLM_ROCE_ALLREDUCE_MAX_SIZE="2MB"
export NCCL_BUFFSIZE="1048576"
export NCCL_MAX_CTAS="8"
export CUTE_DSL_ARCH="sm_121a"
export SAFETENSORS_FAST_GPU="1"
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD="spawn"
export VLLM_SSM_CONV_STATE_LAYOUT="DS"
export VLLM_USE_AOT_COMPILE="1"
export VLLM_USE_MEGA_AOT_ARTIFACT="1"
export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER="1"
export B12X_POLICY_MODE="auto"
export VLLM_MXFP8_LM_HEAD="1"
export VLLM_B12X_MOE_FP4_LAYER_MAX_INPUT_SCALE="w13"
export VLLM_B12X_MOE_FP4_FORCE_A16="1"
export B12X_W4A16_A4_PREFILL="1"

vllm serve nvidia/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP4-Local \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 8000 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
  --pipeline-parallel-size 1 \
  --mamba-cache-mode align \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  --enable-chunked-prefill \
  --dtype bfloat16 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --quantization modelopt_mixed \
  --block-size 16 \
  --load-format b12x \
  --max-model-len 262144 \
  --max-num-seqs 16 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 4096 \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":4, "draft_tensor_parallel_size": 2 }' \
  --gdn-decode-kernel b12x \
  --linear-backend b12x \
  --moe-backend b12x \
  --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune \
  --mm-encoder-tp-mode data \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3 \
  --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --compilation-config '{"pass_config":{"fuse_act_quant":true}}' \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.7 \
  --nnodes 2 \
  --node-rank 0 \
  --master-addr "$HEAD_IP" \
  --master-port "$MASTER_PORT"

recipes.notes: Use the same CX7 port on every node; assign both port subinterfaces on separate subnets; cache the image and checkpoint on every node; start workers before the head. Docker runs privileged. For text-only use, add `--language-model-only` to the vLLM command: the vision encoder is not loaded, which shortens startup and frees its memory, and multimodal inputs are rejected.

recipes.security: Evaluation configuration only. Host networking exposes vLLM on host interfaces; use a firewall or reverse proxy, a scoped read-only HF token, and isolated model storage. The launch exposes `/dev/infiniband`, installs a pinned NCCL wheel when each container starts, and modifies persistent host networking with sudo; review these requirements before use. topology.summary: 2× DGX Station with 1× GB300 each; one node rank per station; tensor parallel 2 over one 400 Gb/s ConnectX-8 RoCE v2 rail

runtime.label: Container (ARM64)
runtime.setup_instructions: Use Bash and replace every placeholder. Set `NTP_HOST` only when the NTP route needs correction. Start it on the worker with `NODE_ROLE=worker`; the worker waits up to six hours for the replicated checkpoint unless `MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` is overridden. Then run it on the head with `NODE_ROLE=head`; the head downloads and replicates the checkpoint. Passwordless SSH to the worker RoCE address is required.
runtime.setup_command:
set -euo pipefail

HEAD_IP="<head-roce-ip>"
WORKER_IP="<worker-roce-ip>"
RAIL_IFACE="<roce-interface>"
RAIL_HCA="<roce-hca>"

IMG=vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0-aarch64
MODEL_REPO=nvidia/GLM-5.2-NVFP4
MODEL_REV=aec724e8c7b8ee9db3b48c01c320f63f9cdaf8aa
MODEL_HOST="<model-host-path>"
CONTAINER=glm52-full
PORT=8000

NODE_ROLE="<head-or-worker>"
case "$NODE_ROLE" in
  head)
    NODE_IP=$HEAD_IP
    PEER_IP=$WORKER_IP
    ;;
  worker)
    NODE_IP=$WORKER_IP
    PEER_IP=$HEAD_IP
    ;;
  *)
    echo "NODE_ROLE must be head or worker" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

if nmcli -t -f NAME connection show | grep -Fxq cx8-rail1; then
  sudo nmcli connection modify cx8-rail1 \
    connection.interface-name "$RAIL_IFACE" connection.autoconnect yes \
    ipv4.method manual ipv4.addresses "$NODE_IP/24" ipv4.never-default yes \
    ipv6.method disabled 802-3-ethernet.mtu 9000
else
  sudo nmcli connection add type ethernet ifname "$RAIL_IFACE" con-name cx8-rail1 \
    connection.autoconnect yes ipv4.method manual ipv4.addresses "$NODE_IP/24" \
    ipv4.never-default yes ipv6.method disabled 802-3-ethernet.mtu 9000
fi
sudo nmcli connection up cx8-rail1

test "$(cat /sys/class/net/$RAIL_IFACE/mtu)" = 9000
ethtool "$RAIL_IFACE" | grep -q 'Speed: 400000Mb/s'
ethtool "$RAIL_IFACE" | grep -q 'Link detected: yes'
ping -I "$RAIL_IFACE" -M do -s 8972 -c 3 "$PEER_IP"

GID_INDEX=$(/usr/sbin/show_gids 2>/dev/null | \
  awk -v d="$RAIL_HCA" -v ip="$NODE_IP" \
    '$1==d && $5==ip && $6=="v2" {gid=$3} END {if (gid!="") print gid}')
test -n "$GID_INDEX"
echo "$RAIL_HCA $NODE_IP GID_INDEX=$GID_INDEX"

for c in port_rcv_errors port_xmit_discards symbol_error link_error_recovery link_downed; do
  test "$(cat /sys/class/infiniband/$RAIL_HCA/ports/1/counters/$c)" = 0
done

NTP_HOST=${NTP_HOST:-}
if [ -n "$NTP_HOST" ] && \
   NTP_IP=$(getent ahostsv4 "$NTP_HOST" 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1 {print $1}') && \
   [ -n "$NTP_IP" ] && \
   ip route get "$NTP_IP" | head -1 | grep -q 'dev docker0'; then
  MGMT_IFACE=$(ip route show default | awk 'NR==1 {print $5}')
  MGMT_GW=$(ip route show default | awk 'NR==1 {print $3}')
  MGMT_CON=$(nmcli -g GENERAL.CONNECTION device show "$MGMT_IFACE")
  sudo ip route replace "$NTP_IP/32" via "$MGMT_GW" dev "$MGMT_IFACE"
  nmcli -g ipv4.routes connection show "$MGMT_CON" | grep -q "$NTP_IP/32" || \
    sudo nmcli connection modify "$MGMT_CON" +ipv4.routes "$NTP_IP/32 $MGMT_GW"
  sudo systemctl restart systemd-timesyncd
fi
test "$(timedatectl show -p NTPSynchronized --value)" = yes

if [ "$NODE_ROLE" = head ]; then
  mkdir -p "$MODEL_HOST"
  docker run --rm --network host \
    -v "$MODEL_HOST:/model" --entrypoint bash "$IMG" -lc \
    "exec hf download '$MODEL_REPO' --revision '$MODEL_REV' --local-dir /model"

  ssh "$WORKER_IP" "mkdir -p '$MODEL_HOST'"
  rsync -aH --info=progress2 --exclude '.cache/' \
    "$MODEL_HOST/" "$WORKER_IP:$MODEL_HOST/"

  LOCAL_MANIFEST=$(find "$MODEL_HOST" -path '*/.cache' -prune -o \
    -type f -printf '%P %s\n' | sort | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
  REMOTE_MANIFEST=$(ssh "$WORKER_IP" "find '$MODEL_HOST' -path '*/.cache' -prune -o \
    -type f -printf '%P %s\\n' | sort | sha256sum" | awk '{print $1}')
  test "$LOCAL_MANIFEST" = "$REMOTE_MANIFEST"
  test "$(find "$MODEL_HOST" -maxdepth 1 -name 'model-*-of-00047.safetensors' | wc -l)" = 47
  echo "MODEL_READY $LOCAL_MANIFEST"
else
  mkdir -p "$MODEL_HOST"
  MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=${MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-21600}
  test "$MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS" -gt 0
  MODEL_WAIT_DEADLINE=$((SECONDS + MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS))
  NEXT_PROGRESS=$SECONDS
  while :; do
    SHARD_COUNT=$(find "$MODEL_HOST" -maxdepth 1 \
      -name 'model-*-of-00047.safetensors' | wc -l)
    if test "$SHARD_COUNT" = 47; then
      break
    fi
    if (( SECONDS >= MODEL_WAIT_DEADLINE )); then
      echo "Timed out after ${MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS} seconds waiting for model replication; found $SHARD_COUNT/47 shards in $MODEL_HOST" >&2
      find "$MODEL_HOST" -maxdepth 1 -name 'model-*.safetensors' \
        -printf '  %f\n' | sort >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    if (( SECONDS >= NEXT_PROGRESS )); then
      echo "Waiting for model replication: $SHARD_COUNT/47 shards"
      NEXT_PROGRESS=$((SECONDS + 60))
    fi
    sleep 10
  done
  test "$(find "$MODEL_HOST" -maxdepth 1 -name 'model-*-of-00047.safetensors' | wc -l)" = 47
  echo "MODEL_READY"
fi

IMG=vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0-aarch64

  awk -F, '$2 ~ /GB300/ {gsub(/ /,"",$1); print $1; exit}')

NODE_IP=$HEAD_IP

prerequisites: Two DGX Stations with one GB300 each connected over one 400 Gb/s ConnectX-8 RoCE v2 rail.
Docker access on both nodes with permission to select the GB300 by UUID and expose `/dev/infiniband`.
NetworkManager, ethtool, show_gids, rsync, and passwordless SSH from the head to the worker RoCE address.
limitations: Validated only on two DGX Stations with one GB300 per node over ConnectX-8 RoCE v2.

Context is capped at 98,304 tokens with `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.93`; this image allocates the sparse-MLA prefill workspace after KV sizing, and higher utilization or longer context ran out of memory on the first long prompt.
The setup configures a persistent NetworkManager profile named `cx8-rail1` and requires jumbo frames with MTU 9000.
recipes.security: Evaluation configuration only. Host networking exposes vLLM on host interfaces; use a firewall or reverse proxy, a scoped read-only HF token, and isolated model storage. The launch exposes `/dev/infiniband`, installs a pinned NCCL wheel when each container starts, and modifies persistent host networking with sudo; review these requirements before use. For production, pin tested image, model, and code revisions.

runtime.label: Container (ARM64)
runtime.setup_instructions: Use Bash and replace every placeholder. Set `NTP_HOST` only when the NTP route needs correction. Start it on the worker with `NODE_ROLE=worker`; the worker waits up to six hours for the replicated checkpoint unless `MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` is overridden. Then run it on the head with `NODE_ROLE=head`; the head downloads and replicates the checkpoint. Passwordless SSH to the worker RoCE address is required.
runtime.setup_command:
set -euo pipefail

HEAD_IP="<head-roce-ip>"
WORKER_IP="<worker-roce-ip>"
RAIL_IFACE="<roce-interface>"
RAIL_HCA="<roce-hca>"

IMG=vllm/vllm-openai:v0.30.0-aarch64
MODEL_REPO=nvidia/GLM-5.3-NVFP4
MODEL_REV=e3b8f9f2fad29727dfa95e766c5cac18ea1414bf
MODEL_HOST="<model-host-path>"
CONTAINER=glm53-full
PORT=8000

NODE_ROLE="<head-or-worker>"
case "$NODE_ROLE" in
  head)
    NODE_IP=$HEAD_IP
    PEER_IP=$WORKER_IP
    ;;
  worker)
    NODE_IP=$WORKER_IP
    PEER_IP=$HEAD_IP
    ;;
  *)
    echo "NODE_ROLE must be head or worker" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

if nmcli -t -f NAME connection show | grep -Fxq cx8-rail1; then
  sudo nmcli connection modify cx8-rail1 \
    connection.interface-name "$RAIL_IFACE" connection.autoconnect yes \
    ipv4.method manual ipv4.addresses "$NODE_IP/24" ipv4.never-default yes \
    ipv6.method disabled 802-3-ethernet.mtu 9000
else
  sudo nmcli connection add type ethernet ifname "$RAIL_IFACE" con-name cx8-rail1 \
    connection.autoconnect yes ipv4.method manual ipv4.addresses "$NODE_IP/24" \
    ipv4.never-default yes ipv6.method disabled 802-3-ethernet.mtu 9000
fi
sudo nmcli connection up cx8-rail1

test "$(cat /sys/class/net/$RAIL_IFACE/mtu)" = 9000
ethtool "$RAIL_IFACE" | grep -q 'Speed: 400000Mb/s'
ethtool "$RAIL_IFACE" | grep -q 'Link detected: yes'
ping -I "$RAIL_IFACE" -M do -s 8972 -c 3 "$PEER_IP"

GID_INDEX=$(/usr/sbin/show_gids 2>/dev/null | \
  awk -v d="$RAIL_HCA" -v ip="$NODE_IP" \
    '$1==d && $5==ip && $6=="v2" {gid=$3} END {if (gid!="") print gid}')
test -n "$GID_INDEX"
echo "$RAIL_HCA $NODE_IP GID_INDEX=$GID_INDEX"

for c in port_rcv_errors port_xmit_discards symbol_error link_error_recovery link_downed; do
  test "$(cat /sys/class/infiniband/$RAIL_HCA/ports/1/counters/$c)" = 0
done

NTP_HOST=${NTP_HOST:-}
if [ -n "$NTP_HOST" ] && \
   NTP_IP=$(getent ahostsv4 "$NTP_HOST" 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1 {print $1}') && \
   [ -n "$NTP_IP" ] && \
   ip route get "$NTP_IP" | head -1 | grep -q 'dev docker0'; then
  MGMT_IFACE=$(ip route show default | awk 'NR==1 {print $5}')
  MGMT_GW=$(ip route show default | awk 'NR==1 {print $3}')
  MGMT_CON=$(nmcli -g GENERAL.CONNECTION device show "$MGMT_IFACE")
  sudo ip route replace "$NTP_IP/32" via "$MGMT_GW" dev "$MGMT_IFACE"
  nmcli -g ipv4.routes connection show "$MGMT_CON" | grep -q "$NTP_IP/32" || \
    sudo nmcli connection modify "$MGMT_CON" +ipv4.routes "$NTP_IP/32 $MGMT_GW"
  sudo systemctl restart systemd-timesyncd
fi
test "$(timedatectl show -p NTPSynchronized --value)" = yes

if [ "$NODE_ROLE" = head ]; then
  mkdir -p "$MODEL_HOST"
  docker run --rm --network host \
    -v "$MODEL_HOST:/model" --entrypoint bash "$IMG" -lc \
    "exec hf download '$MODEL_REPO' --revision '$MODEL_REV' --local-dir /model"

  ssh "$WORKER_IP" "mkdir -p '$MODEL_HOST'"
  rsync -aH --info=progress2 --exclude '.cache/' \
    "$MODEL_HOST/" "$WORKER_IP:$MODEL_HOST/"

  LOCAL_MANIFEST=$(find "$MODEL_HOST" -path '*/.cache' -prune -o \
    -type f -printf '%P %s\n' | sort | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
  REMOTE_MANIFEST=$(ssh "$WORKER_IP" "find '$MODEL_HOST' -path '*/.cache' -prune -o \
    -type f -printf '%P %s\\n' | sort | sha256sum" | awk '{print $1}')
  test "$LOCAL_MANIFEST" = "$REMOTE_MANIFEST"
  test "$(find "$MODEL_HOST" -maxdepth 1 -name 'model-*-of-00050.safetensors' | wc -l)" = 50
  python3 -c "import json; c=json.load(open('$MODEL_HOST/config.json')); assert c['architectures']==['GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM']; assert c['quantization_config']['quant_algo']=='MIXED_PRECISION'; print('CONFIG_OK')"
  echo "MODEL_READY $LOCAL_MANIFEST"
else
  mkdir -p "$MODEL_HOST"
  MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=${MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-21600}
  test "$MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS" -gt 0
  MODEL_WAIT_DEADLINE=$((SECONDS + MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS))
  NEXT_PROGRESS=$SECONDS
  while :; do
    SHARD_COUNT=$(find "$MODEL_HOST" -maxdepth 1 \
      -name 'model-*-of-00050.safetensors' | wc -l)
    if test "$SHARD_COUNT" = 50; then
      break
    fi
    if (( SECONDS >= MODEL_WAIT_DEADLINE )); then
      echo "Timed out after ${MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS} seconds waiting for model replication; found $SHARD_COUNT/50 shards in $MODEL_HOST" >&2
      find "$MODEL_HOST" -maxdepth 1 -name 'model-*.safetensors' \
        -printf '  %f\n' | sort >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    if (( SECONDS >= NEXT_PROGRESS )); then
      echo "Waiting for model replication: $SHARD_COUNT/50 shards"
      NEXT_PROGRESS=$((SECONDS + 60))
    fi
    sleep 10
  done
  test "$(find "$MODEL_HOST" -maxdepth 1 -name 'model-*-of-00050.safetensors' | wc -l)" = 50
  echo "MODEL_READY"
fi

limitations: Validated only on one DGX Station with one GB300 using the pinned ARM64 vLLM image and immutable checkpoint revision shown below.

Context is capped at 131,072 tokens.
The container runs privileged so it can clear the host page cache before vLLM starts.
